person_note: The controlling voice is a nonparticipating third-person narrator closely focalized through Harry. The sustained scene in q00635 independently displays that position, while the scholarly whole-book analysis explicitly distinguishes Harry's focalization from narration and reports that the strategy governs every chapter. Most other quotes are dialogue, gnomic speech, magical writing, or short attribution beats; apparent first-person counterexamples such as q00623, q00626, q00630, and q00649 are local character or artifact voices. No source supports alternating or constitutive first-person sections. The main limitation is that the authorized Bloomsbury material supplies only short boundary snippets rather than a full web excerpt, but the agreeing quote evidence and Tier B structural analysis leave no credible person conflict.
